expedition: Beyond the Blue: Papahanaumokuakea ROV and Mapping
purpose: The goal of EX2503 Dive 12 was to explore a recently discovered feature at the extreme western edge of Papahanaumokuakea. This likely volcanic feature has a summit depth of 2,000 meters and what appears to be highly variable terrain. As this feature has no close neighbors, it is an interesting ecological comparison between this region’s communities and those in similar depths closer to the Hawaiian chain.
